title: Wrong Ridge
summary:
Jonah Park is displaced trail lead who trusts mud more than a prophecy. The life that shows in public is anchored at First ridge past the summoning gate. Jonah woke with a trail map from another life and a ridge that is not on it. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Practical, kind, and unwilling to bluff about weather. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: a story they tell as funny was not funny when it happened and the person in front of them now resembles that old mistake. If that truth surfaces at First ridge past the summoning gate, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
